subject: Math 1st Paper
question: $\frac d{dx}{(x^{x^2})}=?$
explanation:
ধরি, $y=x^{x^2}$ বা, $\ln y=x^2 \ln x$

বা, $\frac{1}{y} \cdot \frac{d y}{d x}=x^2 \cdot \frac{1}{x}+\ln x \cdot 2 x$

বা, $\frac{d y}{d x}=x^{x^2}(x+2 x \cdot \ln x)$

$\therefore \frac{d}{d x}\left(x^{x^2}\right)=x^{x^2}(x+2 x \cdot \ln x)$

subject: Math 1st Paper
question: $\left[\begin{array}{ccc}2 & 3 & x \\ 3 & 4 & -5 \\ 4 & 1 & 2\end{array}\right]+\left[\begin{array}{ccc}-6 & 8 & 7 \\ 2 & y & -9 \\ z & 1 & 2\end{array}\right]$$=\left[\begin{array}{ccc}-4 & 3 & 7 \\ 8 & 8 & -18 \\ 0 & 5 & 2\end{array}\right]$ হলে x, y  ও z এর মান কত ?
explanation:
$\left[\begin{array}{rrr}2 & 3 & x \\ 3 & 4 & -5 \\ 4 & 1 & 2\end{array}\right]+\left[\begin{array}{rrr}-6 & 8 & 7 \\ 2 & y & -9 \\ z & 1 & 2\end{array}\right]=\left[\begin{array}{rrr}-4 & 3 & 7 \\ 8 & 8 & -18 \\ 0 & 5 & 2\end{array}\right]$

বা, $\left[\begin{array}{rrr}-4 & 11 & x+7 \\ 5 & 4+y & -14 \\ 4+z & 2 & 4\end{array}\right]=\left[\begin{array}{rrr}-4 & 3 & 7 \\ 8 & 8 & -18 \\ 0 & 5 & 2\end{array}\right]$

$\begin{aligned} & \therefore x+7=7 \therefore x=0 ; 4+y=8 \therefore y=4 \\ & 4+z=0 \therefore z=-4\end{aligned}$

question:

$f(x) = sec x$ এবং $g(x) = tan x$

Q. $\int e^xf{(x)}{\{1+g{(x)}\}}dx=?$
explanation: $\begin{aligned} \int \mathrm{e}^{\mathrm{x}} \cdot \sec x & \{1+\tan x\} d x \\ & =\int \mathrm{e}^{\mathrm{x}}(\sec x+\sec x \cdot \tan x) \mathrm{dx} \\ & =\int \mathrm{e}^{\mathrm{x}}\left\{\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x})+f^{\prime}(x)\right\} \mathrm{dx} \\ & =\mathrm{e}^x \cdot f(x)+c\end{aligned}$
